interview_question: Following a release, users report that saved changes sometimes disappear. Explain how you would investigate the defect, implement a correction, and verify it.
candidate_answer: I'd reproduce the lost-update behaviour and compare successful and failed saves. I'd inspect application logs and recent persistence changes to locate the fault, correct the responsible logic, then test failed-save scenarios and run regression tests.
definition: Connects the proposed correction to an identified cause.
